title: DOC-082: Recommendation Service Caching Guidelines
content: Recommendation items are compute-intensive. CACHE_TTL_SECONDS MUST NEVER be lower than 300 seconds to protect the product catalog database from stampede queries during traffic surges.

title: RUNBOOK-CART-04: Resolving Cart Memory Leaks & OOMKilled
content: If cartservice pods enter CrashLoopBackOff due to OOM, increase deployment container memory limit from 256Mi to 512Mi. Note: Do not touch redis connection settings.

title: SOP-110: Checkout Service Latency SLAs and Timeouts
content: All downstream calls from checkoutservice must enforce a deadline under 800ms. Any external dependency call exceeding 800ms will cause upstream context cancellation in the frontend gateway.
